doc.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017

title: Opening at the MLA conference in Orlando
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Vincent Pelote of the Institute of Jazz Studies and starts with an easy question.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Orlando at the MLA conference, and I’m very happy to have Vincent Pelote with me today, Director of Operations at the Institute of Jazz Studies at Rutgers. Welcome.
You’ve been perking my ears up the last couple of days when I hear you talking to other people. And I can sense your passion for jazz and I’m going to start out with an easy question.
Thank you. I like easy questions.
